transcript: Did you know that if you press this point on your wrist for 30 seconds, your stress and anxiety may disappear almost immediately? In ancient Eastern medicine, this pressure point was believed to calm the nervous system and slow the chaos inside the mind. Most people live every day in survival mode. Too much noise, too many thoughts, too much fear about the future. But the body remembers peace when you give it a moment to breathe. So before you panic, before you overthink, before you let anxiety control your entire day, press this point gently, take a deep breath and allow your mind to slow down. Sometimes healing does not begin with medicine. Sometimes it begins with stillness.
